title: hybrid-constraint-engine-and-stream-framing-shim-for-compat-layer
author: Dana Ortiz
description: Introduce a hybrid constrained-decoding backend that combines a lightweight context-free-grammar (CFG) matcher with a prioritized regex engine and a tokenizer-aware shim to improve structured-output stability in streaming and OpenAI-compatible tool/function calling scenarios. Motivation: recent customer reports and internal evals showed intermittent truncation or malformed tool-call payloads when constraints hit tokenizer boundary edge cases or when streaming frames were split mid-token. This PR implements a fallback ordering based on specificity and estimated latency, a fast tokenizer-aligned post-filter that patches split-token matches, and a small streaming framing shim to emit safe partial JSON/tool-call frames while preserving top-level structural guarantees. The description below summarizes changes, test coverage, and rollout plan.
